title: The Amazon River
text: The Amazon River in South America is the world's largest river by discharge volume of water and, depending on measurement method, either the longest or second-longest river in the world, with a length of approximately 6,400 km. It originates in the Andes of Peru and flows through Brazil before emptying into the Atlantic Ocean. The Amazon basin drains an area of about 7 million square kilometers. The river has over 1,000 tributaries, seventeen of which are longer than 1,500 km. The average depth of the Amazon is approximately 20–50 meters, reaching over 90 meters in some sections, and its flow represents about 20% of all freshwater discharged into the world's oceans.
